scientific_integrity: An exact-integer positive-matrix exponential enclosure and Collatz–Wielandt comparison establish the witness; lower-dimensional boundary follows published symmetric-migration monotonicity. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: A strict period-reversal witness for a three-patch two-season fixed-conservative-migration model, plus sharp patch/regime counts; does not determine optimal period or cover other parameter families. The three-season counterexample and general failure of monotonicity were already published. Publication-priority checking is nonexhaustive.
title: Exact two-season nonmonotonic growth in a minimal three-patch metapopulation
